targets.review_note: Choose initial lane opposite first obstacle. Each change in blocked lane forces one switch in the intervening open integer interval. Taking its earliest feasible position dominates later choices for every future cooldown; extra switches cannot improve feasibility. If interval cannot accommodate the switch, its ending obstacle is the furthest reachable point.
